label: Women's T20
methodology: The 100 most recent eligible international matches in the downloaded archive. First innings only, replayed at completed-over checkpoints using only deliveries available at that checkpoint. Full-length six-ball-over matches, including all-out innings that reached all checkpoints; rain-adjusted and no-result matches excluded. Historical replay of the current model, not an out-of-time training holdout. Existing model priors and learned adjustments may incorporate historical information. Eligibility favours longer innings; this is not a random sample of all matches. Women's fixtures now use the women's fielding rating keys.
summary: Across 500 predictions the model has an MAE of 16.6 runs and RMSE of 23.1 runs. Bias is +2.1 runs (the model overshoots on average). Final-wicket MAE is 1.76 wickets, with a signed bias of -1.31 wickets (predicted minus actual). Exact final-wicket counts occur in 17.8% of checkpoint predictions. The predicted range captures the actual score 56.0% of the time with an average range width of 31 runs. Error by final score bucket: low-scoring (<160): 14.0 runs MAE, mid-range (160–200): 27.1 runs MAE, high-scoring (200+): 23.4 runs MAE. Predictions are least accurate at the 6-over checkpoint (MAE 25.2 runs) and most accurate at 16 overs (MAE 9.8 runs).
